dbo.user_licenses.summary: License or resource assignment records for user license assignment.
safeReportingNotes: Use user license assignment records for read-only diagnostics only, and avoid exposing security-sensitive values.

In the reviewed LFDS 12.0.2607.421 sample, all 12 assignment SIDs resolved to directory_objects.sid. Visible matching user entries showed Full license, but this does not establish all license UUID meanings or a complete license-availability calculation.

The reviewed Overview Full license availability implied 17 consumed licenses: 12 assignments here plus 5 Full repository named users allocated to Server in Applications. Do not calculate total license consumption or availability from user_licenses alone; this reconciliation is sample-specific and does not establish all allocation rules.
Resolve labels optionally: the observed assigned type did not match license_aliases.uuid. Preserve assignments when an alias is absent.
